subject: Calibration now follows the playbook: begin/end plus speech marks
body: Per D-coord-012, calibration windows come from the playbook. Proposal D-sensing-006: call sensing.calibration.begin(stateId, 'peak') at 1.2 and handle.end() at 1.5, then begin(stateId, 'contrast') at 3.1 and end() at 3.2. Store both summaries on the state. The phases are voice-paced, so no fixed seconds; record(stateId, seconds, phase) stays for the scripted path. Please send handle.mark('speech-start' / 'speech-end') from your voice activity, for both guide and person: talking dominates RMSSD, so I exclude those seconds. Low quality is flagged and used as a prior, as you asked. This replaces the neutral block and record(20) per emotion in D-onboarding-004. Can your voice stack emit those marks?
